text.guided: Your shots end on the right point, but the ball crosses a wall on the way. The landing point is the same for any order of the shots, so choose a different split: go over or around the wall first, then finish the move.
text.fast: The sum is order-independent, the path is not. Re-split the move so no segment crosses a wall.

scene.caption: Two shots can reach the same point by different paths
The landing point is the sum; the route is your choice
